thig9.1:1.1: samatto. || mā su te Vaḍḍha lokamhi vanatho ahu kudācanaṃ | mā puttaka punappunaṃ ahu dukkhassa bhāgimā. || ||
thig9.1:2.1: sukhaṃ hi Vaḍḍha munayo anejā chinnasaṃsayā | sītibhūtā damappattā viharanti anāsavā. || ||
thig9.1:3.1: teh' ānuciṇṇaṃ isībhi maggaṃ dassanapattiyā | dukkhass' antakiriyāya tvaṃ Vaḍḍha anubrūhaya. || ||
thig9.1:4.1: visāradā va bhaṇasi etam atthaṃ janetti me | maññāmi nūna māmike vanatho te na vijjati. || ||
thig9.1:5.1: ye keci Vaḍḍha saṅkhārā hīnaukkaṭṭhamajjhimā | aṇu pi aṇumatto pi vanatho me na vijjati. || ||
thig9.1:6.1: sabbe me āsavā khīṇā appamattassa jhāyato | tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thig9.1:7.1: uḷāraṃ vata me mātā patodaṃ samavassari | paramatthasaññitā gāthā yathāpi anukampikā. || ||
thig9.1:8.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā anusiṭṭhiṃ janettiyā | dhammasaṃvegam āpādiṃ yogakkhemassa pattiyā. || ||
thig9.1:9.1: so 'haṃ padhānapahitatto rattindivam atandito | mātarā codito santo aphusiṃ santim uttamaṃ. || ||
